create_identity.note: did:ethr is implicit: identityOwner(rsu) = rsu until changed

anchor_key_by_rsu.note: RSU publishes its verification key (setAttribute, 1 year)

hand_control_to_authority.note: changeOwner: the road authority controls the RSU's identity from here on

rotate_key_by_authority.note: authority rotates the RSU key (new attribute; the old one stays until it expires or is revoked)

revoke_old_key.note: revokeAttribute of the old key (ERC-1056 has no identity-level revocation; the credential registry is the revocation path for messages)
